priorityFindings.current: Always-on +2 melee damage typed rule despite sidecar text requiring half HP
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Core p284 has NO Ferocity racial trait at all, only Toughness, breathe underwater, expert swimmer.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Verify other-book provenance; at minimum prevent unconditional +2 melee damage and ensure no unsupported automatic boost.

priorityFindings.publishedRule: Core Hutt p284–285 prints Large size effects, speed 2, Force Resistance, Supreme Stability and Persuasion reroll, no species +5 Fort.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Require independent published provenance; remove unsupported executable defense rule if unsourced.

priorityFindings.summary: Gotal emotional reading incorrectly rendered as general blindsense
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Printed 6-square ability is an active Perception check versus Will to identify emotion; Sensor Cones allow two specific Use the Force applications untrained.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Do not convert emotion reading into spatial blindsense; source-check alias then remove or scope unsupported sense rule.

priorityFindings.current: Always-on movement mode fly, speed 6, combatMovement true; text claims immunity to falling damage
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Published near-Human Nyriaanan has no wings or gliding trait. Its full sidebar lists Survival class skill, bonus feat, Low-Light Vision.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Confirm no independent variant; surgically remove unsupported flying speed rule rather than alter canonical player-facing species.

priorityFindings.summary: Celegian untrained Telepathy exception incorrectly grants Force Training
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Broadcast Telepath permits ONLY the Telepathy application of Use the Force untrained without Force Sensitivity; willing within 60 squares LOS auto succeeds; does not grant Force Training
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Remove/unwire unconditional Force Training entitlement; preserve only scope-limited Telepathy and no extra powers.

priorityFindings.current: Typed abilityScoreModifier dexterity -4 when always; pack has printed -2 DEX
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Threats p117 gives -2 DEX; -4 penalties are INT, WIS, CHA.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Remove/correct duplicated or wrong -4 DEX typed rule, prove final actor has -2 only.

priorityFindings.current: ['Aleena','Basic Caamasi in: Species','Caamasi','Medium','6 more Caamasi 1 Edit']
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Automatic languages are Aleena and Basic.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Replace malformed array with ['Aleena','Basic']; trace upstream parser and do not leak adjacent Caamasi page text.

priorityFindings.publishedRule: Legacy p214 male receives +2 DEX, -2 WIS, -2 CHA.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Implement canonical male profile or mandatory sex-based selection, without using a zero-adjustment fallback.

priorityFindings.current: Variant +2 WIS, -2 CHA; lacks +2 INT and -2 DEX
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Legacy p214 female receives +2 INT, +2 WIS, -2 DEX.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Fix published female profile in source/selector; preserve choice identity and test final actor modifiers.

priorityFindings.summary: Mantellian Savrip natural claws and poison
priorityFindings.fileField: data/species-traits-migrated.json: Mantellian Savrip.structuralTraits[Natural Weapons,Poison].rules; packs/species.db: system.naturalWeapons
priorityFindings.current: Two independent 1d4 claw rules; no structured pack claw entry
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Threats p117 grants one 1d6 slashing +STR natural claw; poison is a rider on damaging a living target.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Implement single 1d6 claw form and separate on-hit poison rule, not a second weapon.

priorityFindings.publishedRule: Printed Lugubraa are armed with barbed tentacles 1d6 AND teeth 1d4.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Surgically represent both distinct natural attacks with correct damage and no duplicate materializations.
Use 1d6 in both pack and sidecar; verify actor claw creation
priorityFindings.book: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide

priorityFindings.current: Pack grants Improved Damage Threshold to ALL Ebruchi
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Printed Conditional Bonus Feat only grants Improved Damage Threshold when CON score is 13 or greater.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Change to a properly gated one-time racial entitlement and preserve stable species ID; verify at CON 12 vs 13.

priorityFindings.current: Only Strength 13 required in pack; grants at first level
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Source requires BOTH Martial Arts I and STR 13 to take Mighty Swing as bonus feat.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Apply both prerequisites; test negative paths and prevent unconditional feat grant.

priorityFindings.current: Long Tof campaign narration mistakenly classified as a canonical Ssi-Ruuk trait
priorityFindings.publishedRule: The Ssi-ruuk printed species block has four traits: conditional feat, Force Blind, Keen Smell, Natural Armor.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Remove just this accidental racial trait from source projection and dependent sidecars; preserve unrelated narrative as lore if appropriate.

priorityFindings.summary: Sorcerer of Rhand missing ability penalties
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Printed -2 STR/-2 DEX/+4 INT/+2 WIS/-2 CHA.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Correct the existing profile's negative modifiers without silently treating transformation as a biological starting species.

priorityFindings.publishedRule: Printed automatic languages are Basic and Neimoidian, with no language called 'speak'.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Remove only the stray 'speak' language token; retain Basic/Neimoidian and stable identity.

priorityFindings.current: level-4-two-abilities; maximum +1 per ability; two separate +1 instructions
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Printed clone receives fixed 15/13/10/12/10/8 and ONE chosen ability +2 at creation.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Align chooser to single +2 selection. Do not alter correct fixedScores/bonusValue=2; test preview and commit, avoid double spending/choosing.

priorityFindings.current: Can reroll any intimidation Persuasion check and keep better result
priorityFindings.publishedRule: Source requires a FAILED Persuasion Intimidate check while clad in traditional masks AND garments; the Vagaari counts as trained in Persuasion FOR THAT ACTION.
priorityFindings.proposedAction: Restore all predicates without creating permanent Persuasion training.

surgicalBatches.title: Unsafe typed passives and fabricated powers
surgicalBatches.test: Untargeted attacks, defenses, senses and movement no longer gain unauthorized modifiers; the published legitimate narrow benefit remains.

surgicalBatches.title: Ability scores, corrupted strings, and level-one variant choices
surgicalBatches.test: On newly created actors, correct ability offsets, legal language tokens, exactly one clone +2 and legal male/female alternatives; keep IDs.

surgicalBatches.title: Natural weapon records and on-hit conditional effects
surgicalBatches.test: Exact natural weapon count, attack die/type, no duplicate claw or poison weapon; poison only on qualifying claw damage.

surgicalBatches.title: First-level species feat eligibility and skill gates
targets: scripts/species/species-grant-ledger-builder.js (only if a failing test establishes runtime need)
surgicalBatches.test: Racial feat granted only if actual prerequisite holds; once-only grants; class skills resolve before skill training.

surgicalBatches.title: Vision, immunities, and conditional bonuses
surgicalBatches.test: Printed specific affected defense and Use the Force conditions, not unconditional or blanket Force immunity.

surgicalBatches.title: Special activated racial actions
targets: existing species action/passive consumers only where tested
surgicalBatches.test: Use correct range, action, attire/failure predicates and once-per-encounter charges; do not invent token position automation.

surgicalBatches.title: Cross-book printed conflicts and variants
targets: rolling source ledger and existing supported variants
surgicalBatches.test: Choose explicit source precedence; never merge Bith, Chiss, Neimoidian, Krevaaki or Barabel contradictory printings into an invented composite.

surgicalBatches.title: Unverified 39 pack identities
surgicalBatches.test: Find official primary book/page or Wizards web source or mark supplemental/homebrew/unconfirmed; no production deletion on absence of evidence.
